summary: Reusable app logo: a small animated orbit icon with an optional MOMENTUM OS name and version line.
purpose: Shows the brand in headers, menus, and other places that need it.
why: Likely reason: one logo component keeps the brand look the same everywhere.
how: Takes a size, whether to show the text, and optional extra styles. Draws an SVG with two rings, a dot on the outer ring, and a glowing centre, using colour gradients. Hovering rotates the icon. If the text is on, adds the name and version beside it.
outputs: A logo element on the page.
risks: Gradient ids are fixed names, so two logos on one page may clash in some browsers. The version label is typed by hand.
debug: If the icon looks blank, check the gradient definitions. If the text is wrong, check the name and version lines. If the icon does not rotate on hover, check the hover class.
